# Results report (auto-generated by `scripts/07_make_report.py`)

Main configuration: feature set **C**, horizon **T = 100**, selected by lowest grouped-CV RMSE (training cells) of the final ensemble (CV RMSE by set: A: 227.5, B: 228.3, C: 225.8).
Best individual model (by training CV): **plsr**. Final ensemble (by training CV): **stack_rf_xgb_mlp**.
Test = 42 locked BatteryML MATR-1 test cells; mean ± std over 10 seeds; 95 % CI = cell bootstrap of the seed-averaged RMSE. CV RMSE = grouped 5-fold OOF RMSE on the 41 training cells (stacks: cross-fitted).
